topic.title: Causal Representations and Generative Causal Inference
topic.overview: Causal representation learning seeks internal variables that support reasoning about interventions rather than only correlations. This topic combines generative models, identifiability assumptions, conditional sampling, and partial domain knowledge. It includes anti-causal settings where labels generate observed features, requiring care about which relationships should remain stable across environments.
topic.whyItMatters: A representation useful for prediction may not support valid counterfactual or interventional queries. Structure, supervision, and assumptions about mechanisms determine what can be identified. Incorporating expert knowledge can improve inference, but uncertainty about that knowledge should remain visible rather than being hidden inside a flexible model.
topic.evolution: A 1993 multiple-cause model studies latent explanations for binary observations, predating the modern interventional frameworks represented here. Later work develops causal learning theory and deep generative estimands. A 2025 anti-causal framework separates levels of representation; 2026 work conditions causal foundation models on full or partial graph information through learned attention biases.
openQuestions: Which partial causal facts most improve inference when the full graph is unknown?
How can representations be tested for intervention validity beyond predictive invariance?

papers.title: CausalPFN: Amortized Causal Effect Estimation via In-Context Learning
papers.tldr: CausalPFN learns once from simulated causal settings to estimate treatment effects and uncertainty on new datasets without further tuning.

papers.title: CausalVerse: Benchmarking Causal Representation Learning with Configurable High-Fidelity Simulations
papers.tldr: CausalVerse combines realistic simulated visuals with configurable, known causal processes to evaluate causal representation learning.

papers.title: CCL: Causal-aware In-context Learning for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.tldr: CCL selects in-context examples through learned causal features to improve transfer across distributions.

papers.title: DeCaFlow: A deconfounding causal generative model
papers.tldr: DeCaFlow trains once from observational data and a causal graph to answer identifiable causal and counterfactual questions under hidden confounding.

papers.title: Demystifying Spectral Feature Learning for Instrumental Variable Regression
papers.tldr: Spectral alignment and instrument strength explain when spectral-feature instrumental variable regression is optimal, sample-hungry, or unsuccessful.

papers.title: Disentangling misreporting from genuine adaptation in strategic settings: a causal approach
papers.tldr: The paper estimates average misreporting by comparing how reported features relate causally to downstream variables in manipulated and unmanipulated data.

papers.title: Do-PFN: In-Context Learning for Causal Effect Estimation
papers.tldr: Do-PFN learns from synthetic causal structures to estimate intervention effects from observational data without a supplied causal graph in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Exploiting LLMs for Automatic Hypothesis Assessment via a Logit-Based Calibrated Prior
papers.tldr: A calibrated distribution derived from LLM logits helps rank observed correlations by how surprising they are relative to model expectations.

papers.title: From Black-box to Causal-box: Towards Building More Interpretable Models
papers.tldr: A graphical criterion identifies which counterfactual questions a model architecture can support and characterizes the associated predictive tradeoff.

papers.title: GST-UNet: A Neural Framework for Spatiotemporal Causal Inference with Time-Varying Confounding
papers.tldr: GST-UNet combines spatiotemporal neural modeling with iterative G-computation to estimate intervention effects while adjusting for time-varying confounding.

papers.title: LLM Interpretability with Identifiable Temporal-Instantaneous Representation
papers.tldr: A theoretically grounded causal representation framework extends sparse autoencoders to uncover both time-delayed and instantaneous concept relationships in LLMs.

papers.title: Measure-Theoretic Anti-Causal Representation Learning
papers.tldr: ACIA learns two levels of anti-causal representations to capture observation generation and stable patterns across changing environments.

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Causal Inferences
papers.tldr: A calibration-based theory and deconfounded training objective support treatment-effect estimation in an unlabeled experiment using a related labeled experiment.

papers.title: Revealing Multimodal Causality with Large Language Models
papers.tldr: MLLM-CD combines contrastive factor discovery, statistical causal inference, and counterfactual reasoning to uncover multimodal causal structure.

papers.title: Sample-efficient Learning of Concepts with Theoretical Guarantees: from Data to Concepts without Interventions
papers.tldr: The framework aligns unsupervised causal representations with interpretable concepts using few labels, with theoretical guarantees and no interventions.

papers.title: SPARTAN: A Sparse Transformer World Model Attending to What Matters
papers.tldr: SPARTAN learns sparse, context-dependent object interactions to improve world-model prediction, adaptation to changed dynamics, and distractor robustness.

papers.title: The third pillar of causal analysis? A measurement perspective on causal representations
papers.tldr: A measurement-based view of causal representations motivates T-MEX, a score for assessing identification and usefulness in downstream causal tasks.

papers.title: UnCLe: Towards Scalable Dynamic Causal Discovery in Non-linear Temporal Systems
papers.tldr: UnCLe estimates time-varying causal influences using learned temporal dependencies and prediction-error responses to perturbations.

papers.title: Alleviating Observation Bias via Causal-Invariant Meta-Learning for Unbalanced Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
papers.tldr: CIMLN combines context-based missing-view recovery with clustering consistency across masking patterns to reduce observation bias.

papers.title: Anti-causal domain generalization: Leveraging unlabeled data
papers.tldr: Under an anti-causal structure, unlabeled data across environments can guide predictors toward robustness to certain distribution shifts.

papers.title: Barriers to Counterfactual Credit Attribution for Autoregressive Models
papers.tldr: Counterfactual attribution does not automatically compose across generated tokens, and black-box retrofitting requires exponentially many queries in output length.

papers.title: Bayesian Meta-Learning with Expert Feedback for Task-Shift Adaptation through Causal Embeddings
papers.tldr: Causal task embeddings and noisy expert feedback help Bayesian meta-learning reduce harmful transfer to unfamiliar tasks.

papers.title: Causal Feature Learning via Generalized Rayleigh Quotients
papers.tldr: Causal Feature Learning balances temporal prediction with environment mean invariance to improve fault detection under changing operating conditions.

papers.title: Causal Fine-Tuning under Latent Confounded Shift
papers.tldr: Causal Fine-Tuning separates stable and shift-sensitive representations to improve robustness against misleading correlations in text.

papers.title: CausalProfiler: Generating Synthetic Benchmarks for Rigorous and Transparent Evaluation of Causal Machine Learning
papers.tldr: CausalProfiler generates synthetic causal benchmarks with explicit assumptions, known answers, and coverage guarantees across three levels of causal reasoning.

papers.title: CausalX: A Unified and Causally-Interpretable Plug-and-Play Model for Multi-modal Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.tldr: CausalX combines dynamically learned causal graphs with multiple structural constraints to improve and interpret multimodal forecasting.

papers.title: CauSciBench: Can LLMs Automate Causal Inference in Real-World Scientific Research?
papers.tldr: CauSciBench tests complete causal inference workflows and finds that selecting the right method is a major obstacle for frontier models.

papers.title: CauseCollab: Causal Unified and Modality-Agnostic Network for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
papers.tldr: CauseCollab improves collaborative perception by separating shared semantic content from modality-specific effects in exchanged features.

papers.title: ConTSG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Conditional Time Series Generation
papers.tldr: ConTSG-Bench evaluates conditional time-series generators for both realistic outputs and adherence to diverse conditioning information.

papers.title: CURVE: Learning Causality-Inspired Invariant Representations for Robust Scene Understanding via Uncertainty-Guided Regularization
papers.tldr: CURVE uses uncertainty-guided regularization to learn sparse scene relationships that transfer more reliably across environments.

papers.title: Cycle-of-Science: Reliable Reasoning through Counterfactual Verification for Agent Decision Making
papers.tldr: Cycle-of-Science trains agents to improve decisions through repeated hypothesis testing, counterfactual experiments, and causal validation.

papers.title: DISCO: Mitigating Bias in Deep Learning with Conditional Distance Correlation
papers.tldr: DISCO turns a causal independence criterion into scalable training regularizers that mitigate observed dataset biases.

papers.title: Domain Adaptive Object Detection via Dynamic Causal Refinement
papers.tldr: Dynamic Causal Refinement improves cross-domain object detection by targeting both domain-specific shortcuts and misleading cues shared across domains.

papers.title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.tldr: Interventional visual attribution helps diagnose whether robot policies rely on task-irrelevant cues associated with poor generalization.

papers.title: Factored Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.tldr: Factored Classifier-Free Guidance uses causal structure to control image attributes separately and reduce unintended counterfactual changes.

papers.title: From Generalist to Specialist Representation
papers.tldr: The paper establishes nonparametric identifiability results for task structure across time and task-relevant latent representations under sparsity regularization.

papers.title: Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series
papers.tldr: Function-valued analysis reveals state-dependent causal relationships that single-number edge scores can obscure in nonlinear time-series models.

papers.title: Generative Augmented Inference
papers.tldr: GAI uses AI outputs as informative features for human labels, enabling valid inference and conditional efficiency gains from combined human and AI data.

papers.title: Interpretable Neural ODEs for Gene Regulatory Network Discovery under Perturbations
papers.tldr: PerturbODE uses interpretable neural differential equations to infer gene regulatory networks and predict responses to genetic interventions.

papers.title: Interventional Processes For Causal Uncertainty Quantification
papers.tldr: A Gaussian process construction provides tractable uncertainty estimates for entire causal intervention functions, with a procedure for calibrating posterior coverage.

papers.title: Learning General Causal Structures with Hidden Dynamic Process for Climate Analysis
papers.tldr: CaDRe jointly models hidden climate drivers and causal links among observed variables, with conditional identifiability guarantees and interpretable empirical results.

papers.title: Linear Causal Representation Learning by Topological Ordering, Pruning, and Disentanglement
papers.tldr: The proposed linear causal-representation algorithm recovers latent features up to an equivalence class under weaker environmental and distributional assumptions.

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability as Statistical Estimation: A Variance Analysis
papers.tldr: Circuit discovery inherits and amplifies variable causal-effect estimates, motivating routine statistical stability checks in mechanistic interpretability.

papers.title: Outcome-Aware Spectral Feature Learning for Instrumental Variable Regression
papers.tldr: Outcome-aware spectral features improve instrumental-variable regression when conventional features poorly represent the causal function.

papers.title: Position: Causality Is Key for Interpretability Claims to Generalise
papers.tldr: The paper uses causal reasoning to clarify which interpretability claims observations, interventions, and stronger assumptions can support.

papers.title: Relational Structural Causal Models
papers.tldr: Relational causal models establish conditions for answering queries about unseen object combinations and outperform non-relational baselines in simulated traffic scenes.

papers.title: Shapley Regularized Neural Granger Causality
papers.tldr: Info-Shap connects global feature attribution to Granger non-causality and supports regularizers that improve temporal structure recovery.

papers.title: Spiked-CFR: Causal Representation Learning from LLMs via Wasserstein Projection Pursuit
papers.tldr: SPIKED-CFR improves causal learning from text embeddings by balancing a low-dimensional bias subspace under an explicit spiked-structure assumption.

papers.title: Test-Time Learning of Causal Structure from Interventional Data
papers.tldr: TICL combines test-time self-augmentation with Joint Causal Inference to learn causal structure and identify intervention targets.

papers.title: Unveiling Prior-Data Fitted Networks on Causal Effect Estimation: Pre-Training or Fine-Tuning?
papers.tldr: The paper identifies intervention-prior coverage limits in causal PFN pretraining and proposes targeted and meta-sampling fine-tuning to address them.

papers.title: Use What You Know: Causal Foundation Models with Partial Graphs
papers.tldr: Conditioning causal foundation models on full or partial causal knowledge lets a general-purpose model match specialized models in experiments.

papers.title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
papers.tldr: PerturbedVAE separates sparse perturbation effects from dominant unchanged expression patterns to improve cellular-response prediction and interpretation.

papers.title: Who Gets Credit or Blame? Attributing Accountability in Modern AI Systems
papers.tldr: The framework estimates how individual training stages affect model behavior without retraining, helping locate stages associated with spurious correlations.
